title: S100P Interacts with p53 while Pentamidine Inhibits This Interaction.
authors: Katte, Revansiddha H; Dowarha, Deepu; Chou, Ruey-Hwang; Yu, Chin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究S100P与p53蛋白间的相互作用及戊烷脒的抑制效应，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子建模，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，方法上分子建模为辅且无AI/物理模拟核心建模，与本课题TF-DNA互作关联较弱。
abstract: S100P, a small calcium-binding protein, associates with the p53 protein with micromolar affinity. It has been hypothesized that the oncogenic function of S100P may involve binding-induced inactivation of p53. We used (1)H-(15)N HSQC experiments and molecular modeling to study the molecular interactions between S100P and p53 in the presence and absence of pentamidine. Our experimental analysis indicates that the S100P-53 complex formation is successfully disrupted by pentamidine, since S100P shares the same binding site for p53 and pentamidine. In addition, we showed that pentamidine treatment of ZR-75-1 breast cancer cells resulted in reduced proliferation and increased p53 and p21 protein levels, indicating that pentamidine is an effective antagonist that interferes with the S100P-p53 interaction, leading to re-activation of the p53-21 pathway and inhibition of cancer cell proliferation. Collectively, our findings suggest that blocking the association between S100P and p53 by pentamidine will prevent cancer progression and, therefore, provide a new avenue for cancer therapy by targeting the S100P-p53 interaction.
abstract_zh: S100P，一种小钙结合蛋白，以微摩尔亲和力与p53蛋白结合。已有假设认为S100P的致癌功能可能涉及结合诱导的p53失活。我们利用(1)H-(15)N HSQC实验和分子建模研究了在有无喷他脒存在下S100P与p53之间的分子相互作用。我们的实验分析表明，S100P-p53复合物的形成被喷他脒成功破坏，因为S100P与p53和喷他脒共享相同的结合位点。此外，我们展示了喷他脒处理ZR-75-1乳腺癌细胞导致增殖减少及p53和p21蛋白水平升高，表明喷他脒是一种有效的拮抗剂，干扰S100P-p53相互作用，从而重新激活p53-21通路并抑制癌细胞增殖。总体而言，我们的发现表明，通过喷他脒阻断S100P与p53之间的结合将阻止癌症进展，因此，为靶向S100P-p53相互作用的癌症治疗提供了新途径。
